jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer – Backend / API Engineering
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Backend / API) to join a contractor program supporting a critical customer engagement: a state government professional licensing and regulatory compliance platform built on Google Cloud. This is greenfield work — infrastructure, data and CI/CD are in place, and the application services are still to be built. This role is ideal for a senior backend engineer with deep Java and Spring Boot experience who owns core domain services end to end and designs the APIs the rest of the platform is built on. The successful candidate will build the licensing, case management, payments, document and notification services and the public and internal API surface, working closely with the client technical lead, the integration engineers, and the mobile and frontend engineers to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery.

  

Expected start date: 5 October 2026\.

  

REQUIRED CREDENTIALS

* 8\+ years of professional backend engineering experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Production delivery experience on Google Cloud Platform
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Java 21 and Spring Boot 3\.x microservice development
* API design and ownership: REST, OpenAPI specification, versioning, pagination, error contracts, backward compatibility
* PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query tuning, and versioned migrations
* GCP serverless services: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Scheduler
* Event\-driven architecture and messaging patterns (idempotency, retries, dead\-letter handling)
* API security with OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC and JWT, including role\- and attribute\-based authorization
* Automated testing (JUnit, integration tests) and CI/CD
* Observability of owned services: structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs

  

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience in government or regulated environment

jobs.title: Business Analyst- Contractor
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Customer and Consumer Engineering department is responsible for set of applications and products which cover the end\-user experience for Align customers. This includes doctor portal, practice and patient mobile apps, remote monitoring solution and many more. Each team is agile and self\-sufficient, covering the full stack: backend services (Java, Typescript, Ruby) and frontend (React, Angular). The department is distributed across the globe, yet we're aiming for collocation within each team.  

  

The team we're hiring for is working on a new customer experience, that runs on the new set of core services and aims to replace an existing doctor portal. The project is large and has lots of moving parts and substreams to navigate through. And that's why we need your help!  

  

We are looking for a business analyst, who will lead the business projects from requirements and solution side, working with the stakeholders and maintaining the development process.### **Role expectations**

  

* Analyzing incoming requirements and converting them into features or stories, that should include details about system expected behavior, business rules, design constarints, etc. Therefore technical expertise is strongly required.
* Technical solution development and documentation with diagrams, system requirements and contracts.
* Dividing larger features into the system\-level user stories for development team.
* Participation in teams scrum rituals (stand ups, plannings, demos, etc)
* Supporting teams during the development: clarifying requirements, helping SQA with test scenarios coverage, organizing external demo sessions, etc.
* Maintaining teams project and system documentation \- specs, contracts, SRSes
* Planning, performing and implementing process improvement initiatives to make sure that the team stays on top of things.

  

### **What we're looking for**

  

* 3\+ years of experience in IT industry.
* Understanding of REST/Hypermedia API. Basic
